about_short_description.short_description: Takalam is an online counseling platform for a digital solution for mental well-being.

product.name: Takalam Online Counseling Platform
product.description: A web and mobile platform for booking and conducting private online counseling sessions with licensed mental health professionals in Arabic, English, and other supported languages.

product.name: Aila
product.description: A 24/7 AI well-being companion that provides Arabic- and English-language conversational support for everyday emotional reflection and mental wellness.

product.name: Corporate Employee Wellbeing Programs
product.description: Organizational mental health programs that provide employees with access to culturally relevant counseling and wellbeing support to address stress, burnout, and workplace challenges.

identifier.value: White-Label Digital Wellbeing Solutions and Clinical Integrations

product.name: White-Label Digital Wellbeing Solutions and Clinical Integrations
product.description: Customizable digital mental health solutions for organizations, including white-label platforms and integrations for hospitals and healthcare facilities.

product.name: Digital Wellbeing Tools
product.description: Self-guided tools for monitoring mood, reflecting on emotional progress, and accessing guided meditations and other structured wellbeing resources.

identifier.value: CSR and Community Mental Health Programs

product.name: CSR and Community Mental Health Programs
product.description: Sponsored mental health access programs delivered through corporate social responsibility and impact partnerships for communities with limited access to care.
